subject: Per-descriptor image view format must follow translator plan
body: Another shared contract point: n2t_texture_layout.format alone is the texture allocation Metal format, but plan WriteSource::Texture/Combined ImageSource carries ImageViewDesc.format/components/level/twin/shader_swizzle. The view format can be a STORAGE ALIAS (e.g half bits via UINT), or raw UNORM view of sRGB, different from own Metal format. Do not always pack t->format after compiling bound variant. Add explicit supported view-format representation/options, or translate the exact VkFormat into an audited equivalent n2t format; reject unrepresentable aliases. Honor ImageViewDesc.level relative to parent/view first level; honor shader_swizzle to avoid double-swizzling. Pinned bind/plan.rs813-843 documents all. Test one texture with sampled and storage alias views in one kernel, including half NaN/raw integer bit preservation and nonzero level view. No depth twin support should be implied unless actual twin storage/sync exists.
